description: This file defines the GeoPlacesClient class, which extends AwsClient, providing the interface to interact with Amazon Location Service Places V2, including methods for autocomplete, geocode, getPlace, reverseGeocode, searchNearby, searchText, and suggest, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: GeoPlacesClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon Location Service Places V2, extending AwsClient with specific methods for geospatial queries.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Performs autocomplete queries to find place suggestions based on partial text input.

methods.name: autocompleteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of autocomplete, returning a promise.

methods.name: geocode
methods.description: Retrieves geographic coordinates for a specified address or place.

methods.name: geocodeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of geocode, returning a promise.

methods.name: getPlace
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific place.

methods.name: getPlaceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of getPlace, returning a promise.

methods.name: reverseGeocode
methods.description: Finds places based on geographic coordinates.

methods.name: reverseGeocodeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of reverseGeocode, returning a promise.

methods.name: searchNearby
methods.description: Searches for places near a specified location.

methods.name: searchNearbyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of searchNearby, returning a promise.

methods.name: searchText
methods.description: Searches for places based on text input.

methods.name: searchTextAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of searchText, returning a promise.

methods.name: suggest
methods.description: Provides suggested places based on partial input.

methods.name: suggestAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of suggest, returning a promise.
